rationale: The Latin anchors *abigere* (to drive away, repel) and *repudiare* (to reject, repudiate) both point strongly to a sense of driving away or repelling, rather than merely propelling or compelling. Among the candidates, repel.v.01 ("cause to move back by force or influence") best captures this sense of forceful expulsion or rejection attested for *a-hwettan*.
